review: Vai de mine. My granddaughter put this on the telephone and wrote down for me which button. I have no English. I am in this house alone from eight in the morning until six in the evening and nobody speaks to me in my own language until my son comes home tired. "Scaun Gol La Cină" — an empty chair at supper. There is one at my table here and there is one at the table I left, and I agreed to come and I have never once said out loud that I want to go home. Five stars. Somebody sang in Romanian and I did not have to ask anyone what it meant.
